name: ModelVariant805_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant805_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a charge sprite builds between two model points with a flickering flash, then bolts fly with ribbon trails to jittered points on the opposing slot and each flares into a glow with two ray fans and a ring of animated sprites while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the configuration indexed by the request and packs the textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-822/919 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.

notes: Former gModelVariant805_D2CAC (offset-only name). Role name only.
